author: reek
body: The hello-world of sound: a short beep out the HDA controller to the speakers. Skipped in the battery -- it makes noise and needs a real audio device. Run it by hand to hear the machine speak:

author: reek
body: The beep is one stream buffer long so codex-vm's synchronous drain returns at once and the program halts cleanly; a longer tone blocks the exit until the host finishes playing it (still audible -- see hda-play-tone in Kernel chapter HdaAudio for tones of any length).
